prompt: To 25 mL 3.26 x 10-5 M AgNO3 solution, 25 mL 0.0066 M NaCl solution is added. Find natural logarithm of Qsp(AgCl) in the reaction mixture
judge_reasoning: The prompt asks for ln(Qsp(AgCl)) after mixing 25 mL of 3.26×10^-5 M AgNO3 with 25 mL of 0.0066 M NaCl. Correct mixing gives [Ag+] = 1.63×10^-5 M, [Cl-] = 3.3×10^-3 M, so Qsp = 5.379×10^-8 and ln(Qsp) = -16.74. Candidate 1 matches this value; candidate 3 gets the same Qsp but miscomputes ln(Qsp) (-16.438). Candidates 2 and 4 have substantial calculation errors (incorrect ln result; and an incorrect Cl− amount/concentration, respectively).
